findings.evidence: Collection glTF exporter replaces at_collection_center boolean with collection_center_mode: WORLD_ORIGIN, CENTER_MASS, OBJECT_POSITION, INSTANCE_OFFSET. Non-world modes adjust root object translations.
findings.limitations: Development/5.3 code, not a stable release benchmark. glTF 2.0 exporter, not evidence of glTF 2.1 interoperability.
findings.engineering: Version-pin exporter and pivot mode in manifests; round-trip room door anchors, object/world transforms and bounds across all four modes; detect legacy boolean script usage.

findings.change: Add multi-scene GPU-instancing, animation remapping, and semantic extras collision gates to existing export experiments.
findings.source_quality: A: upstream merged source diff; B: project applicability
findings.evidence: Blender glTF exporter now removes GPU instance nodes across scenes using old-to-new node maps, fixes animation channel targets, and resolves legacy custom vs system property name conflicts after modifier evaluation.
findings.limitations: No project round-trip tests yet; collision resolution can rename extras. No verified exporter speedup.
findings.engineering: Test multi-scene instancing with animated non-instanced props, instance transforms/counts, animation targets, old pre-4.2 custom properties, and stable semantic IDs after export.

watch_only.why: Point-cloud glTF attributes/radius export fix is not Gaussian splat export.
Attribute remapping preserves interleaved and half-float metadata; no new priority.
Grid primitive optimization has no relevant published benchmark.
